## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation where necessary.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or sensitive data.
- [ ] The change is focused and ready for review.
